origin.description: Run code with R_MAKEVARS_USER pointing at a rewritten Makevars file.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while R_MAKEVARS_USER points at the new file.

arguments.name: path
arguments.text: Existing Makevars file to start from.

origin.details: The rewritten file is removed afterwards and R_MAKEVARS_USER is restored.
origin.example:
src <- tempfile()
writeLines("CFLAGS = -O2", src)
before <- Sys.getenv("R_MAKEVARS_USER")
lines <- with_makevars(c(CFLAGS = "-O3"), readLines(Sys.getenv("R_MAKEVARS_USER")), path = src)
c(lines, if (identical(Sys.getenv("R_MAKEVARS_USER"), before)) "restored" else "open")

translation.description: Run code with R_MAKEVARS_USER pointing at a rewritten Makevars file.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while R_MAKEVARS_USER points at the new file.

arguments.name: path
arguments.text: Existing Makevars file to start from.

translation.details: The rewritten file is removed afterwards and R_MAKEVARS_USER is restored. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

fd, src = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
with open(src, "w") as handle:
    handle.write("CFLAGS = -O2\n")
before = os.environ.get("R_MAKEVARS_USER")
lines = with_makevars(
    {"CFLAGS": "-O3"},
    lambda: open(os.environ["R_MAKEVARS_USER"]).read().splitlines(),
    path=src,
)
after = os.environ.get("R_MAKEVARS_USER")
os.remove(src)
return lines + ["restored" if after == before else "open"]
